Brand guideline · The mark in the wild

Where the mark meets the world.

Verdigris carries recognition. The people carry the warmth: calm, collaborative, quietly smart. The white mark is the bridge that signs the frame without stepping on either. Every lockup here is built to the construction spec, caps at 0.73 of the mark, gap at 0.20, one single colour.
